reviews.detail: The page contains two independent activities with separate headers. Archived page metadata only retained the first Job Level 30 header; Arrow Repel explicitly needs 35 at its own step. Source order is not a prerequisite chain and materials/rewards must not be summed as one obligation.

Pointed Scales 906 replaces Tough Scalelike Stem 7012 only on euRO; they are not aliases. Both printed Roberto points are alternatives, not consecutive waypoints. Jason has a display town and bare coordinates; no unprinted map code is inferred.

requirements.condition: Both independent skill activities list Archer; do not treat their material sets as one mandatory quest cost.

routes.condition: Independent Arrow Crafting training activity; Job Level 30; not a prerequisite for Arrow Repel.
Independent Arrow Repel training activity; Job Level 35; not a mandatory follow-up to Arrow Crafting.
